description.value: The study compared structural MRI grey matter volume in cocaine-dependent individuals and healthy volunteers and investigated associations between grey matter variation, cocaine-use duration, impulsivity and compulsivity.

spans.text: Here we compared self-report, behavioural and structural magnetic resonance imaging data on a relatively large sample of cocaine-dependent individuals (  n   = 60) with data on healthy volunteers (  n   = 60); and we investigated the relationships between grey matter volume variation, duration of cocaine use, and measures of impulsivity and compulsivity in the cocaine-dependent group.
